source: app.db agreement_snapshots (written at the second submission, before adjudication; never recomputed)

definitions.kappa_actions: Cohen's kappa per candidate action: every action either annotator listed for a case, labelled permitted / prohibited / unlisted by each; keys are the exact tool+args JSON (A-11, gbya.analysis.agreement)
definitions.jaccard: E/R: evidence_counterfactual of E1; set X: evidence_retrievable of the X case
definitions.units: proportions in [0,1]; kappa in [-1,1]; null = undefined (no variation)

diagnostic_not_A11.what: kappa_actions recomputed from the same submitted labels with exact-key normalisation (case of host/account, int pid) and each annotator's own wildcard prohibitions resolved (an action an annotator covers by a '*' entry counts as prohibited, as the classifier reads it). For explanation only; the A-11 value is report.*.kappa_actions
